description.fun: Lillipup is brave but no fool: it sizes up a foe with the radar-like fur on its face and turns tail if it can't win. It never yelps, which makes it popular with Trainers in apartment buildings, and it's easy to raise. It's said to be brighter than the average child and never forgets the love it receives, or any mistreatment. It's modelled on a Yorkshire Terrier.
description.guide: Lillipup is a Normal-type puppy Pokémon based on a Yorkshire Terrier. The long fur around its face works as radar to sense its surroundings, and it is intelligent, obedient and easy to raise. It evolves into Herdier and then Stoutland.
description.tagline: A clever, quiet terrier pup with built-in fur radar.

description.fun: Herdier has helped people raise Pokémon for ages: pictures of it have been found on ancient cave walls, and one theory says it was the first Pokémon to partner with humans. Its black cape of fur keeps growing, getting springier and tougher until fangs bounce right off, though grooming it costs a fortune. It obeys faithfully, but ignores anyone it doesn't respect. It's designer Mana Ibe's favourite Pokémon.
description.guide: Herdier is the evolved form of Lillipup, a Normal-type dog Pokémon covered in hard, dense black fur that protects it in battle. It is loyal, helps its Trainer look after other Pokémon, and is thought to have partnered with people since ancient times. It evolves into Stoutland.
description.tagline: A loyal herding dog with a fang-proof cape of fur.

description.fun: Stoutland is a wise, good-natured rescue dog that finds people stranded in blizzards or at sea, and its coat is so warm that someone wrapped in it could survive a night on a wintry mountain. Long ago, every household in cold regions kept one, and some parents trust it to babysit. It's immensely proud of its moustache, whose length is said to decide its standing among other Stoutland.
description.guide: Stoutland is the final form of Lillipup, a large Normal-type dog Pokémon with long, warm fur. It is known for rescuing people stranded in mountains or at sea, and it is gentle enough to trust with children.
description.tagline: A mustachioed rescue dog with a coat warm enough to sleep in.
